name: gtm-recruiting
description: GTM recruiting playbook — active sourcing, passive candidate outreach, offer negotiation, recruiter partnerships (Betts, It's Destiny Recruiting), and inclusive hiring without tokenization. Use when recruiting SDR/AE/CS/leaders, closing candidates, negotiating OTE/equity, or building diverse GTM benches. Triggers on: "recruit salesperson", "negotiate offer", "close candidate", "Betts recruiting", "diversity hiring sales", "passive candidate outreach", "sales offer negotiation", "contingency recruiter", "Destiny recruiting".
